arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Waxman argued the conflict between state and federal law is stark.
Kneedler argued state duties conflict with the FDA safety determination.
Frederick cited specific regulations to support the preemption argument.
Ginsburg questioned how benefits outweigh the risk of amputation.

paragraphs: This case defines the balance between federal drug regulation and state tort law. It determines whether injured patients can sue manufacturers under state law. It shapes the scope of federal preemption in product liability.
